backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC 8-K event metadata uses pit_safe usable_trade_date. OHLCV filters are observed through the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: FD/Other 8-K disclosures with an immediate positive issuer reaction may identify incremental continuation candidates beyond earnings and annual reports.

2_history_check.exp-20260504-037: Tested FD/Other negative-reaction satellite overlay. This run tests positive-reaction continuation as a direct issuer candidate pool, not negative mean reversion.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-010_and_011: SEC Item 2.02 peer-transfer variants were rejected. This run excludes Item 2.02 and uses direct issuer FD/Other rows.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-014: Direct 10-K liquidity/RS filing source was rejected. This run uses 8-K FD/Other current-report events.
2_history_check.recent_dividend_scout: A pre-run deterministic SEC dividend-increase text scout left only six paper trades and negative PnL, so it was not chosen as the formal experiment.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; no EV- or PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: PIT-safe SEC 8-K Item 7.01/8.01 FD/Other filings with positive same-day issuer reaction, liquidity, trend, and relative-strength confirmation may provide a free-data continuation candidate pool.
interpretation: The SEC FD/Other 8-K positive-reaction candidate pool did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby FD/Other positive-reaction thresholds on the same frozen windows without new forward rows or a sharper structured event-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: Forward replacement-value rows or a materially sharper structured SEC event-quality field such as official-customer source, contract value, or disclosure-quality provenance.

source_definition: event row must have pit_safe_flag true and usable_trade_date
earnings 2.02, capital-contract, debt, offering, and governance item codes are excluded
ticker must have exact signal-date OHLCV in the fixed snapshot
close must be above the prior 50-day moving average
20-day return must beat SPY by at least 0 percentage points
20-day average dollar volume must be at least USD 20 million
signal-day ticker-minus-SPY return must be nonnegative
signal-day close location must be at least 0.55
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: Meta research favors production-visible candidate-pool alpha, while nearby SEC peer-transfer and 10-K variants recently failed. FD/Other positive issuer reaction is distinct and sample-rich enough to audit.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

production_parity.parity_note: No production code path is changed. If this were accepted, promotion would require a shared SEC FD/Other paper sleeve with exact item-code, as-of OHLCV, and entry/exit parity tests.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay attribution remains sparse. Skipped Companyfacts, VBB, VCP, state-surface, and OHLCV pattern-name retunes per playbook freeze guidance. This run tests one free SEC event candidate-source variable only.
